headline: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi has guaranteed that no trees will be cut and no new concrete structures built during the upgrade of Islamabad's F-9 Park.

card.desc: No trees cut, no new concrete in Islamabad park revamp.

caption:
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi has guaranteed that no trees will be cut and no new concrete structures built in the upgrade of Islamabad's F-9 Park, Express Tribune reports. The revamp plan includes better lighting, a lake, coffee shops, improved walkways and thousands of additional trees, Dawn adds.
